items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: The Berry Brothers, Ethel Waters, Johnny Hodgins, all the big New York acts would come there.

ctx.x: And I joined the band -- well, after I went to Cincinnati with Leroy Bradley's band, and there we played all the big acts, you know. The Berry Brothers, Ethel Waters, Johnny Hodgins, all the big New York acts would come there.
What was the spot in Cincinnati?
